chunks: Said (the sons): "O our father, pray for us that our sins be forgiven, for we are really sinners."

key_terms.خَاطِئِينَ: Sinners / Those who made a mistake

ai.seo_question: What did Jacob's sons ask their father to do for them?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the high status of the patriarchs, with Jacob (Yaqub) serving as a model of intercessory prayer (Shafa'ah) for his children. The sons' admission of being 'khata'in' (erring/mistaken) reflects the Shia emphasis on sincere repentance (Tawbah) and the recognition of human fallibility even among the righteous, paving the way for familial reconciliation.
